message.content: YurikoYamamoto expresses significant enthusiasm about the potential of binaural tones to add a new dimension to their music. She states, "Absolutely! It could add a whole new dimension to our music. I’m excited to give it a try!" This sentiment indicates her eagerness to explore and implement binaural tones into their performances, believing it could elevate their musical experience and possibly create a unique listening experience for their audience. Her excitement is shared by others in the group, such as ChaeSong-hwa, who notes, "It could add a whole new dimension to our music. I’m excited to give it a try!" LiHua also shares her anticipation, stating, "Just imagining the vibes we could create is exciting." These responses collectively show a collaborative and optimistic attitude towards incorporating binaural tones into their music.
